Hiểu đơn giản, bạn cần nộp thuế giá trị.en: Simply put, you need to pay increased value taxes for both import taxes. So, if the goods had to be heavily imported taxed, by adding the increased value tax would be much higher. In terms of the customs value of the goods you can understand the value of goods when you go to the Vietnamese portal, namely including the price of purchase on the bill and the cost of international transportation. In case your application is free of delivery, the customs value will now equal the value of the purchase bill.
Hiểu đơn giản, bạn cần nộp thuế giá trị.zh: 简言之,你需要支付 增加的增值税 两种进口税。 因此,如果货物必须征收大量进口税,增加增值税将高出很多。 就货物海关价值而言,你去越南门户时可以了解货物价值,即包括账单上的购买价格和国际运输费用。 若您的申请是免费的,则海关价值将等于购买单的价值。

Loại thuế này áp dụng với một số mặt hàn.en: This type of tax applies to some state goods that limit consumption such as alcohol, tobacco. Most of the essentials you need to buy are not going to need to take on this particular kind of tax.
Loại thuế này áp dụng với một số mặt hàn.zh: 这种税种适用于某些限制消费的国产商品,如酒精,烟草. 大部分你需要购买的必需品 不需要承担这种特殊税。

Loại thuế này được đánh giá tương đối ph.en: This type of tax is relatively complicated when you want to import or buy from abroad about Vietnam. It could be said that each of the items would have different tax rates so that the tax had a fairly long import tax board. Importation tax will distinguish mainly through the source of the product. If you enter from the US, the tax will be a lot different than in Japan or Canada, Germany. The U.S. goods are counted according to WTO imports and Chinese goods, Japan counts taxes under the ASEAN and ASEA agreement should have a more favourable rating than the US. For more information, you need to check the import tax board as you need to import the items to be more accurate.
Loại thuế này được đánh giá tương đối ph.zh: 当您想从国外进口或购买越南时,这种税则相对复杂。 可以说,每个项目都有不同的税率,这样税收就有一个相当长的进口税局。 进口税主要通过产品来源加以区分。 如果你从美国入境,税收将大大不同于日本或加拿大,德国. 美国商品根据世贸组织的进口和中国商品计算,日本根据东盟和ASEA协定计税,其评级应该比美国更优惠. 要了解更多信息,请查看进口税板,因为需要输入的商品要更加准确.

Nước ta cấm nhập khẩu đối với các mặt hà.en: The country we banned imports to used items such as textiles, electronic goods, cold electricity, medical equipment, goods and goods is the existing information technology product.
Nước ta cấm nhập khẩu đối với các mặt hà.zh: 我国禁止进口纺织品,电子商品,冷电,医疗设备,商品等废旧物品,是现有的信息技术产品.

Theo quy định pháp luật, lô hàng nhập kh.en: In accordance with the law, import shipments through rapid transfers if valued under 1 million would be tax-free and customs ratings. These shipments were made of customs procedures very quickly due to the free time of tax calculations. On the other hand, the imports per million still have to be counted as normal taxes according to the law.
Theo quy định pháp luật, lô hàng nhập kh.zh: 根据法律,通过快速转移的进口货物,如果价值低于100万,将实行免税和海关评级。 由于可以自由计算税款,这些货物很快通过海关程序运出。 另一方面,每百万人的进口仍然必须依法算作正常税。

Thuế giá trị gia tăng bằng giá trị hải q.en: The tax of value increased by the customs value of the goods plus the special consumption tax plus the import tax and how much is multiplied by the rising price tax.
Thuế giá trị gia tăng bằng giá trị hải q.zh: 增值税按货物关税价值加特别消费税加进口税增加,乘以物价税上涨多少.

Thuế nhập khẩu sẽ bằng giá trị hải quan.en: The import tax will be equal to the customs value of the product times the special consumption tax and times the income tax.
Thuế nhập khẩu sẽ bằng giá trị hải quan.zh: 进口税将等于产品关税价值乘以特别消费税和所得税。

Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt sẽ bằng giá trị h.en: Special consumption tax will be equal to the customs value of the goods side times the rate tax.
Thuế tiêu thụ đặc biệt sẽ bằng giá trị h.zh: 特别消费税将等于货物边税的关税价值乘以税率税。

Đây là loại thuế sử dụng với tất cả các.en: This is the kind of tax used with all the goods with different tax rates. Most exports are taxed 10% like the ones you consume in Vietnam. In the country currently few products or services are favored by the VAT tax. The essential items, such as food or electricity, are usually 5% and the remainder tax is 10%, such as clothing, shoes, cosmetics, perfumes, or technical accessory.
Đây là loại thuế sử dụng với tất cả các.zh: 对所有税率不同的货物都使用这种税。 大部分出口品都被征税10% 就像你在越南消费的一样 在国内,增值税目前很少有利于产品或服务。 食品或电力等必需品通常为5%,其余的税收为10%,如服装、鞋子、化妆品、香水或技术附属品等。
